feasibility.criterion: reset passes validate_start and drifts < 5 mm over 100 steps; a teleported goal drifts < 5 mm over 100 steps and satisfies the postcondition; every raised top centre is below the path-aware reach above its column; every table-level centre is reached; every initial and goal column passes the 50-step primitive reach check (synthesis.cap.generalization.reach: one Move from the start posture to 0.05 m above the top centre, one down to it and one back up, each converging to 2 mm)
